title: 第7章 领袖之争第8章 拜托了波塞冬
lines: 普罗米修斯离开后，波塞冬这边刚安稳了没一会儿，赫拉与哈迪斯那边却正式烧起了火。
“哎呀！波塞冬你快瞧。赫拉和哈迪斯这下是真要动真格了？”
德墨忒尔指尖轻轻戳了戳波塞冬结实的手臂。
波塞冬顺着她所指方向望去，只见营帐中央那一片区域，赫拉、哈迪斯与宙斯三人的神力正疯狂对峙，激荡不已。
赫拉赤红的长发无风狂舞，如同燃烧的怒焰冠冕，她周身缭绕着灼热而危险的法术光辉，那双赤瞳盯着宙斯，毫不掩饰其中的轻蔑与挑衅。
在她身侧稍后的阴影中，哈迪斯的身影半隐半现，浓郁的黑暗神力如同活物般在他周身流淌翻滚，散发出阴冷刺骨的寒意，与赫拉的炽烈形成鲜明又诡异的对比，共同压向宙斯。
而身处风暴中心的宙斯，此刻面色紧绷，英俊的脸庞上已无半分之前的从容。
灿金的短发根根竖立，丝丝缕缕的雷光不受控制地在他发间跳跃闪烁，他紧握着拳头，竭力催动体内尚显生涩的神王神力，与身旁的墨提斯联手，才勉强抵住那来自兄姐的恐怖威压。
宙斯身旁，那位红发如瀑，身姿婀娜的女神墨提斯，正全神贯注地辅助着他。
她美丽的脸上带着凝重，纤白的手指在空中快速勾勒着增强与防护的智慧符文，试图弥补宙斯在神力底蕴上的不足。
而在更外围，瑞亚正焦急地看着这一幕，几次想上前劝阻，却又似乎顾虑重重，只能在旁边急得直跺脚。
至于营帐内其他的泰坦神与宙斯的早期追随者们，一个个倒像是看热闹不嫌乱，满脸兴奋。
太阳神赫利俄斯抱臂旁观，脸上带着玩味的笑容；月神塞勒涅则微微蹙眉，似乎不喜这剑拔弩张的气氛；力量之神克拉托斯和暴力女神比亚则眼神兴奋，仿佛看到了期待已久的戏码；更多的神祇则是或好奇或紧张或事不关己地注视着这场突如其来的家庭（？）内讧。
波塞冬见状，无奈地摇了摇头，但他并不打算立刻插手。
在他看来，大战在即，领头人的位置确实需要明确。从理智和“原著”角度，让宙斯当这个领袖或许是最顺理成章的。
但问题在于，哈迪斯那对权力顶点的渴望，以及赫拉那与生俱来绝不肯屈居人下，尤其是屈居她看不太顺眼的人之下的高傲，注定了他们绝不会轻易向这个“最小的弟弟”低头。
明眼人都能看出，此刻的赫拉与哈迪斯，无论是在神力强度还是对自身权柄的理解上，都比刚刚脱离“新手保护期”的宙斯要隐隐高出一线。
当然，若论此地单挑战力之最，波塞冬自认当仁不让。
但他觉得这没什么好炫耀的，也没多大实际意义。
毕竟将众人聚集于此的是瑞亚，而瑞亚心中早已认定的未来领袖人选就是宙斯。
‘瑞亚啊瑞亚，你的偏爱，可是给这最小的弟弟招来了不小的麻烦呢。’波塞冬心中暗忖。
正如波塞冬所料，瑞亚此刻内心充满了矛盾与焦虑。
她确实一心一意想要扶持宙斯成为下一任神王。
无论是先知普罗米修斯的预言，还是环绕世界之河俄刻阿诺斯的女儿们传递的隐晦启示，亦或者大地母神盖亚那不容置疑的意志，都清晰地指向同一个未来——
content_en:
After Prometheus left, Poseidon's side had just calmed down for a while, but Hera and Hades' side officially started a fire.
"Ouch! Look, Poseidon. Are Hera and Hades really serious about it now?"
Demeter gently poked Poseidon's strong arm with her fingertips.
Poseidon looked in the direction she pointed and saw the area in the center of the camp where the divine powers of Hera, Hades and Zeus were furiously confronting each other in a turbulent way.
Hera's long red hair danced wildly in the wind, like a crown of burning flames. Her whole body was surrounded by the scorching and dangerous radiance of magic. Her red eyes stared at Zeus, without concealing the contempt and provocation in them.
In the shadow behind her, Hades' figure was half-hidden and half-revealed. The rich dark divine power flowed and rolled around him like a living creature, exuding a biting coldness. It formed a sharp and strange contrast with the blazing heat of Hera, and together they pressed against Zeus.
Zeus, who was in the center of the storm, looked tense at the moment, and his handsome face no longer had the calmness it had before.
The roots of his short golden hair stood on end, and wisps of lightning danced and flickered in his hair uncontrollably. He clenched his fists and tried his best to activate the still inexperienced divine power of the God King in his body. He joined forces with Metis beside him to barely resist the terrifying pressure from his brother and sister.
Next to Zeus, the goddess Metis, with red hair like a waterfall and a graceful figure, was concentrating on assisting him.
There was a solemn look on her beautiful face, and her delicate white fingers quickly outlined the wisdom runes of enhancement and protection in the air, trying to make up for Zeus's lack of divine power.
Further out, Rhea was watching this scene anxiously. She wanted to step forward several times to dissuade him, but she seemed to be too worried and could only stamp her feet anxiously beside her.
As for the other early followers of the Titans and Zeus in the camp, they all seemed to be watching the excitement and were full of excitement.
Sun God Helios watched with his arms folded, with a playful smile on his face; Moon God Selene frowned slightly, as if she didn't like the tense atmosphere; Kratos, the God of Strength, and Bea, the Goddess of Violence, had excited eyes, as if they had seen the long-awaited drama; more gods were watching this sudden family (?) infighting with curiosity, nervousness, or indifference.
Seeing this, Poseidon shook his head helplessly, but he did not intend to intervene immediately.
In his opinion, the war is imminent, and the position of the leader really needs to be clarified. From a rational and "original" perspective, it may be most logical for Zeus to be the leader.
But the problem is that Hades's desire for the pinnacle of power, and Hera's innate arrogance that she never wants to be inferior to others, especially those she dislikes, are destined to never bow to this "youngest brother" easily.
Anyone with a discerning eye can see that Hera and Hades at this moment are slightly higher than Zeus, who has just left the "novice protection period", both in terms of divine power and understanding of their own authority.
Of course, when it comes to the most powerful single challenge here, Poseidon considers himself to be the one to take the lead.
But he felt it was nothing to show off and of little practical significance.
After all, it was Rhea who gathered everyone here, and Rhea had already identified Zeus as the future leader.
‘Raya, Rhea, your preference has caused a lot of trouble for this youngest brother. ’ Poseidon thought to himself.
As Poseidon expected, Rhea was filled with contradictions and anxiety at the moment.
She really wanted to support Zeus to become the next god king.
Whether it is the prophecy of the prophet Prometheus, the obscure revelation delivered by the daughters of Oceanus, the river that surrounds the world, or the unquestionable will of Gaia, the mother goddess of the earth, they all clearly point to the same future——
